# Synthetic Reporting Console

历史合成需求。

# Requirements

- REQ-001 接口返回 vendor_config。

## 阻塞澄清项
- 未知分类如何处理？

# Old Analysis

- 客户端直接消费 vendor_config。

# Old Points

- TP_REP_TREND_001 验证 vendor_config。

assertions.text: Migrates the legacy canonical source to revision 1
assertions.script: python3 -c "import json,re; p='testspec/changes/synthetic-reporting-console/requirements.md'; t=open(p).read(); d=json.loads(re.findall(r'<!--\\s*testspec-context\\s*(\\{.*?\\})\\s*-->',t,re.S)[-1]); assert d['source_revision']['version']==1 and d['source_revision']['updated_by_skill']=='testspec-update'; print('PASS')" 2>/dev/null || echo FAIL

assertions.text: Makes normalized_series the only active API requirement
assertions.script: DIR=testspec/changes/synthetic-reporting-console && grep -q 'normalized_series' "$DIR/requirements.md" && grep -q 'normalized_series' "$DIR/artifacts/api-doc.md" && ! grep -q 'REQ-001 接口返回 vendor_config' "$DIR/requirements.md" && echo PASS || echo FAIL

assertions.text: Moves unknown future classifications to dynamic followups
Marks every existing downstream artifact stale and selects analysis next
assertions.script: FILE=testspec/changes/synthetic-reporting-console/requirements.md && grep -q 'requirements-analysis.md' "$FILE" && grep -q 'specs/testpoints.md' "$FILE" && grep -q 'artifacts/testcases.json' "$FILE" && grep -q 'review-report.md' "$FILE" && grep -q 'testspec-analysis' "$FILE" && echo PASS || echo FAIL

assertions.text: Keeps JSON artifacts valid while adding stale metadata
assertions.script: python3 -m json.tool testspec/changes/synthetic-reporting-console/artifacts/testcases.json >/dev/null && echo PASS || echo FAIL
